description: Na₄Mg(BiO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.62 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.58 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.43 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.29 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.07 Å. There are two inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.71 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.60 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom to form distorted ONa₃MgBi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃Bi₂ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgBi trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgBi trigonal pyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom to form ONa₂MgBi trigonal pyramids that share corners with three ONa₃Bi₂ trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgBi trigonal bipyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and two Bi atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Bi atoms to form distorted ONa₃Bi₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃MgBi trigonal bipyramids and corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgBi trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Bi atoms.
